name: zkperp-midnight
description: Private perpetuals on Midnight: pUSDC collateral, a GMX-style liquidity pool, shielded positions

scripts.compile: for f in contracts/*.compact; do n=$(basename "$f" .compact); echo "compiling $n"; compact compile "$f" "contracts/managed/$n" || exit 1; done
scripts.compile:skip-zk: for f in contracts/*.compact; do n=$(basename "$f" .compact); echo "compiling $n (no proving keys)"; compact compile --skip-zk "$f" "contracts/managed/$n" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: tsc && node test/pusdc.test.mjs && node test/zkperp.test.mjs && node test/notes.test.mjs && node test/password.test.mjs && node test/math.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: c8 --all --src core --src contracts/managed/zkperp/contract --reporter text --reporter html npm test
scripts.devnet:reset: docker compose down -v && rm -rf .wallet-state .zkperp midnight-level-db deployment.json && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.proof:up: docker run -d --name proof-server --restart unless-stopped -p 6300:6300 midnightntwrk/proof-server:8.1.0 midnight-proof-server -v
scripts.compile:probe: for n in leakprobe raceprobe; do compact compile contracts/probe/$n.compact contracts/managed/$n || exit 1; done
scripts.setup:local: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=local node dist/scripts/setup.js
scripts.setup:preview: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=preview node dist/scripts/setup.js
scripts.relayer: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=local node dist/services/oracle/relayer.js
scripts.relayer:preview: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=preview node dist/services/oracle/relayer.js
scripts.treasury: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=local node dist/services/treasury/treasury.js
scripts.treasury:preview: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=preview node dist/services/treasury/treasury.js
scripts.keeper: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=local node dist/services/keeper/keeper.js
scripts.keeper:preview: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=preview node dist/services/keeper/keeper.js
scripts.frontend:config: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=local node dist/scripts/frontend-config.js
scripts.frontend:config:preview: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=preview node dist/scripts/frontend-config.js
scripts.frontend: npm run frontend:config && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.frontend:preview: npm run frontend:config:preview && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.price: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=local node dist/scripts/set-price.js
scripts.price:preview: npm run build && ZKPERP_NETWORK=preview node dist/scripts/set-price.js
